title: Atlas service account secret in a Basic envelope
summary: A synthetic encoded credential after the Basic scheme in the Authorization header of a token request, in a raw request, a quoted curl -H argument and a JSON header map. The encoded value is the base64 of a synthetic client id and a synthetic secret joined by a colon.
rationale: Atlas documents one carrier for the service account secret: an HTTP Basic Authorization header carrying the base64 of CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET, posted to the OAuth token endpoint with grant_type=client_credentials. The secret exists only inside the encoded credential, so the extent is the whole encoded token, not a decoded secret-only span. The only documented secret text, mdb_sa_sk_ with an ellipsis, is a truncated example and not a grammar, so the synthetic secret here carries no such prefix and none is claimed. The client id half follows a documented public pattern and is not the secret.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the encoded credential after the Basic scheme in a token request to the Atlas OAuth endpoint is treated as a credential and covered whole. Atlas documents the Basic envelope of client id and secret (carrier existence only); the extent, value admission and generic attribution are the project's decisions. No prefix, alphabet or width of the secret is claimed.

sources.supports: Each service account has a client ID and a rotatable secret that function as a username and a password for creating access tokens.
info.description curl example: Authorization: Basic base64(CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET), grant_type=client_credentials, token endpoint https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/oauth/token

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
